items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno, una de las principales plataformas de música con inteligencia artificial y objeto de demandas por derechos de autor en varios frentes, ha lanzado su suite de modelos v6, la primera que la compañía desarrolla con socios de la industria: Warner Music Group, BMG y Believe. Con este estreno, la firma retira simultáne…

items.title: When It Rains, It Pours: SOCAN Sues Suno for Allegedly ‘Engaging in Rampant Copyright Infringement on a Massive Scale’
items.summary: When it rains, it pours: SOCAN has filed a Suno copyright lawsuit of its own, accusing the platform of unlawfully training on protected works and then generating infringing outputs. SOCAN submitted the straightforward complaint to Canada’s Federal Court today, moments after activist artist David Lowery as well as Latin…

items.title: UMG firma un acuerdo global de IA con ElevenLabs
items.summary: Universal Music Group (UMG) ha firmado un acuerdo de licencia plurianual con ElevenLabs, la compañía de inteligencia artificial de audio valorada en 11.000 millones de dólares. Es el primer pacto de ElevenLabs con una gran discográfica y contempla el lanzamiento de una nueva plataforma de música con IA para fans, ademá…

items.title: Suno lanza un nuevo modelo de IA para música tras múltiples demandas por derechos de autor
Donald Trump’s DoJ says OpenAI should be able to do whatever it wants with copyright protected works
items.summary: The US Department Of Justice has intervened in a legal battle between the New York Times and OpenAI, arguing that AI training is ‘fair use’ under American copyright law. Whether or not AI training is fair use is at the centre of dozens of AI lawsuits, including those filed by the music industry

items.title: Will You Please Stop Suing Us Now? Suno Turns a Legit Leaf With ‘v6’ as Warner Music’s Kyncl Leads the Licensed AI Pep Rally
items.summary: Moments after announcing a Believe partnership deal, Suno is now rolling out its Warner Music- and BMG-backed v6 models – with an eye on expanding into “opt-in experiences built around individual artists.” The sudden shift marks a big departure from earlier, non-licensed content grabs, but is it too late for Suno to sh…

items.title: Adult Film Producer Unmasks Prolific ‘John Doe’ Torrent Pirate as Meta Executive
items.summary: A routine John Doe lawsuit could become part of Strike 3 Holdings' $446 million AI training case against Meta. The adult film producer wants to link the two lawsuits, arguing that a Reality Labs executive downloaded nearly 20,000 files at his home for work purposes, not for personal use. Meta counters that the alleged…

US musicians’ union files opposition to Universal and Warner motions to dismiss, saying members’ recordings were ‘fed into AI systems for commercial exploitation’
items.summary: The American Federation of Musicians has filed its opposition to the motions to dismiss brought by Universal Music Group, Inc., Warner Records, Inc., and Atlantic Recording Corp. in its lawsuit over the labels’ licensing deals with AI companies. items.title: Universal Music and ElevenLabs Ink Multi-Year Partnership Deal, Say They’re Already Developing ‘A New AI-Powered Music Creation Platform’
items.summary: Another day, another high-profile AI licensing deal: Universal Music Group (UMG) and ElevenLabs are now collaborating to develop a “platform built on licensed music and artist participation.” The major label and the well-funded AI developer, which has been aggressively expanding into music since August 2025, formally d…

items.title: Suno unveils upgrade developed with “music industry partners”, while continuing to battle the music industry in court
items.summary: Suno has unveiled v6 of its music AI platform, which has been developed with its industry partners like Warner Music, BMG and Believe. However, even as it starts to work with some labels and publishers on new AI products, it continues to fight other music companies in the courts

items.title: Crear música con IA basada en artistas reales no será un problema por este acuerdo de Suno con Warner Music y BMG

tip.title: Split sheet firmado el mismo día de la sesión
tip.body: Los porcentajes de autoría se pelean cuando la canción pega, no cuando se escribe. Firma el split sheet con todos los presentes antes de salir del estudio, aunque sean amigos.

tip.title: Sign the split sheet the day of the session
tip.body: Songwriting splits get disputed when the song blows up, not when it's written. Sign a split sheet with everyone in the room before you leave the studio —even with friends.
